subject.title: feat(agents): add atomic subagent admission gate

question: Should `sessions_spawn.atomicGate` become a supported host-enforced write-authority contract, or should model/sandbox resolution remain diagnostic metadata outside the public tool API?
rationale: The answer determines both the required enforcement mechanism and whether a receipt may truthfully represent bounded repository-write authority; this is a product and security-boundary choice, not a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Design an enforceable authority capability
options.body: Define a host-owned capability that binds the child attempt, exact resolved model, sandbox policy, and actual writable filesystem scope before exposing an admission receipt.

options.title: Keep the data diagnostic-only
options.body: Remove the authority claim and return existing resolved launch metadata with documentation that it is not a confinement or authorization guarantee.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the new tool surface until agent-runtime owners choose the supported orchestration security model.

recommendation.title: Design an enforceable authority capability
recommendation.body: Define a host-owned capability that binds the child attempt, exact resolved model, sandbox policy, and actual writable filesystem scope before exposing an admission receipt.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner requires the unavailable feature-history provenance pass; this should route to the agent-runtime owners identified by repository history.
